test_title: PYST 66: SSC CGL 2024 - Reasoning (Held On 18 Sept, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Three of the following four letter-clusters are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which is the letter-cluster that does NOT belong to that group?

(Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their positions in the letter-cluster.)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15d4e688c8bdc2766cb74c67a7c0d12a85a1e60bc448f376b860b7949a5ae586.png] 

The logic followed here is:

Option 1) MPR

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bc6f5e3d3836a417bc0a05def0c6772ba02f6a7a82df4d4b64915456261363fa.png] 

Option 2) CFH

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/92ed6b386508bd6702eda86ac3f32b3794994cdee7936208b34fa88d3e87f6b0.png] 

Option 3) IKN

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9156bfc5e13711eb6460e4aa341ec577efac342a3f9d77954b8d9d520aa3cb25.png] 

Option 4) EHJ

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/754a74059570b498e0a3978909f3b030f58fa0ab75f6ac5fa6890832cf90671f.png] 

Thus, out of all the options 'IKN' is the odd one out.

Hence, "Option 3" is the correct answer.
